ns2:course.label: Bassoon
ns2:course.description: Instruction in bassoon at the undergraduate level. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Passing of a performance audition is required prior to the initial registration in any applied music course.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Passing of a performance audition is required prior to the initial registration in any applied music course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Open only to students who have passed a qualifying audition. Non-music majors will be assessed a fee.
